name: @vymalo/opencode-browser-mcp

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open a new browser tab inside a named tab group (creates the group if it doesn't exist yet). Returns the tab id, final URL and page title.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

url.description: URL to load. Omit for a blank tab.

focus.description: Bring the tab to the foreground (default true).

target.description: Which browser to open in (label or id from browser_targets). Omit unless several browsers are connected.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate an existing tab in the group to a new URL.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element. Target it by `ref` (from browser_snapshot, most reliable), CSS `selector`, or absolute `x`/`y` coordinates.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

ref.description: Element ref from a prior browser_snapshot.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_double_click
tools.description: Double-click an element, targeted by `ref`, CSS `selector`, or `x`/`y` coordinates.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

ref.description: Element ref from a prior browser_snapshot.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into the focused element (or first focus `ref`/`selector`). Optionally press Enter after.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

ref.description: Element ref from a prior browser_snapshot.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_fill
tools.description: Fill several form fields in one call. Each field targets a `ref` or CSS `selector` and sets its `value`.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

ref.description: Element ref from a prior browser_snapshot.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_select
tools.description: Choose option(s) in a <select> element, or set the selection of a control.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

ref.description: Element ref from a prior browser_snapshot.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page (or an element). Provide `deltaX`/`deltaY`, or `to: 'top' | 'bottom'`.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

ref.description: Scroll within this element instead of the page.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a single key or chord (e.g. "Enter", "Escape", "Control+a").

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait for a fixed delay (`ms`) or until a `selector` reaches `state` (visible/hidden/attached).

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close a tab (pass `tabId`) or the whole group (omit `tabId`).

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_release
tools.description: Release control of the browser: stop driving and detach the debugger (clears the 'being debugged' banner) without closing tabs. The next browser_* call re-attaches. Use this when you're done so the user gets their browser back.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Capture an accessibility/DOM snapshot of the page with stable element refs. Prefer this over guessing selectors — pass the returned refs to browser_click/type/etc.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_get_text
tools.description: Extract the visible text / readable content of the group's active tab.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List open tab groups and their tabs. Omit `group` to list everything.

group.description: Restrict to one group.

tools.name: browser_targets
tools.description: List the browsers (extensions) currently connected to the bridge, with their id, label, browser and owned groups. Use a returned id/label as `target` in browser_open when several are connected.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the group's active tab. Returns the image (the OpenCode plugin saves it to disk and returns the path — use the read tool to view it).

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page, not just the viewport.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_back
tools.description: Go back in the tab's history.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_forward
tools.description: Go forward in the tab's history.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_reload
tools.description: Reload the group's active tab.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_activate
tools.description: Bring a group's tab to the foreground (focus its window and tab).

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Move the pointer over an element (reveals hover menus/tooltips). Target by `ref`, `selector`, or `x`/`y`.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

ref.description: Element ref from a prior browser_snapshot.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Drag from a source element to a target element (each by `ref` or `selector`).

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_upload
tools.description: Set the files on a file <input>, by absolute path(s) on the machine running the bridge. CDP executor only (Chromium).

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

ref.description: Element ref from a prior browser_snapshot.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_get_html
tools.description: Get the HTML of the page (or of a `ref`/`selector` element). `outer: false` for innerHTML.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

ref.description: Element ref from a prior browser_snapshot.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_get_attribute
tools.description: Read an element's tag, text, value, checked state, bounding box, and attributes (or one named attribute).

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

ref.description: Element ref from a prior browser_snapshot.

name.description: A single attribute name to read.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.

tools.name: browser_query
tools.description: Find visible elements matching a CSS selector. Returns each with a stable ref you can pass to other tools.

group.description: Named tab group the action targets. Created on first browser_open.

tabId.description: Specific tab id; defaults to the group's active tab.
